reproduction.source: Preceding Prompt 2 audit in this session at the same base commit; diagnostic not rerun in Prompt 1.5
reproduction.change: Only canonical runs.validated_plan_json note changed from Plan A to Plan B after approval
reproduction.diagnostic_digest_format: SHA-256 of raw canonical Plan.to_dict JSON, not the new versioned identity; not historical approval proof
reproduction.validation_observation: Changed Plan accepted on repository reopen/get/validate_all

security_invariant: Current authoritative Plan must match retained approval-time exact content/context proof before compilation; Approved state and a valid current Plan alone are insufficient

decision.identity_model: Canonical digest only, with independently joined approval context; no duplicate approved snapshot

canonicalization.convention: Existing canonical_json after strict parser/schema/trusted semantic-risk validation
canonicalization.encoding: UTF-8 without BOM or trailing newline
canonicalization.unicode: Preserve exact code points/string whitespace; no normalization, trimming or reinterpretation
canonicalization.numbers: Existing strict lexical bounded integers only; floats/NaN/infinity rejected; booleans distinct
canonicalization.excluded: No current Plan field excluded; Intent, HTTP credentials, storage paths and approval reason are not Plan fields

digest.approval_context: Server decision IDs/choice/4->5 versions/strict timestamp plus content revision/digest; no extra keys
digest.algorithm_agility: No separate algorithm field; identity revision pins algorithm/input; unknown revision rejected

storage.key: decision_id primary key and FK approval_decisions.decision_id
storage.cardinality: Exactly one companion for every decision; no duplicate/orphan/contradictory row
storage.immutability: Named insert-at-decision/read validation; no update/delete/rebind API; DB shape/key constraints plus application immutability and digest verification
storage.triggers: Not required by this minimum architecture
storage.bound_status_meaning: BOUND_V1 is identity revision 1 inside future SQLite v2, not historical SQLite v1 binding

atomicity.end_state_validation: Complete Run/decision/binding/audit linkage validated before one commit
atomicity.failure: Rollback all facts; uncertain commit safe error, no guessed success/automatic replay
atomicity.duplicate: Existing stale/state conflict; no new decision/event/binding and no digest overwrite

legacy_v1.migration_rule: Preserve all three old tables/rows, add only explicit null-proof companions; never hash current legacy Plan as historical evidence
legacy_v1.reapproval_rule: No reset/re-approval/rebinding of terminal legacy Run; use a distinct v2 Run and new explicit approval
legacy_v1.migrated_awaiting_approval: May receive a genuinely new bound v2 decision after migration; no historical decision invented
legacy_v1.legacy_read: Healthy legacy response/state/version remains unchanged; exact historical Plan NOT PROVEN

future_v2.migration: Explicit offline atomic upgrade with consistent WAL-aware backup under stopped ownership; no startup upgrade
future_v2.fresh_db: Explicit v2 composition initializes same nine-table contract
future_v2.reopen: Validation only; no missing binding/table repair
future_v2.run_reconstruction: Verify bound Approved/Rejected identity before using current Plan for history; startup validates all companions
future_v2.read_failure: Invalid binding -> existing DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE; startup refuses service; healthy legacy status is readable

compiler.binding_precondition: Same transaction loads Run/Plan/decision/companion/history; Approved/v5 + APPROVE4->5 + valid BOUND_V1 + current content/context digest equality
compiler.receipt_replay: Retains receipt-before-CAS order but never bypasses current binding/spec checks
compiler.supported_plan_shape: Whole single append_service_note/1 SIDE_EFFECT Plan for service-demo
compiler.spec_binding: Existing Action spec digest additionally derives linked approval revision/digest; existing approval_decision_id is the reference; no duplicate Action column

api.audit_role: Existing decision_id joins decision and binding; no duplicated digest; logs not authority

APPROVAL_PLAN_BINDING_MISSING.message: The approval has no exact Plan binding.

LEGACY_APPROVAL_UNBOUND.message: The historical approval has no exact Plan binding.

APPROVAL_PLAN_MISMATCH.message: The stored Plan does not match the approval binding.

APPROVAL_PLAN_BINDING_UNSUPPORTED.message: The approval binding format is not supported.

api.error_limit: Typed admission failure; generic Run read retains safe storage response and rejected startup cannot promise an HTTP response; no raw digest/SQL/path/Plan disclosure
binding_error_precedence: After valid Run/decision/history linkage: missing companion or null required BOUND_V1 proof -> APPROVAL_PLAN_BINDING_MISSING
Unknown status/revision, malformed non-null proof or contradictory legacy proof -> APPROVAL_PLAN_BINDING_UNSUPPORTED
FK/cardinality/history corruption retains safe storage errors

tamper_cases.trigger: Approved Plan A replaced with valid Plan B
tamper_cases.expected: Bound content/context mismatch denies read/admission; never rebind
Exact canonical arguments change content digest; deny
Schema/semantic target check or digest mismatch denies
Array order is bound; digest mismatch denies; MVP multi-step whole Plan also denied
Full Plan identity and whole-Plan shape reject; no partial compilation
All current Plan fields including goal/risk bound; unknown fields schema-rejected
Joined links and context digest bind Run/decision/choice/versions/time; copied evidence rejected
LEGACY_UNBOUND returned; historical Run retained; zero Actions/model/tool calls
No overwrite/rebinding; bound corruption denied before or during guards; healthy duplicates retain existing CAS/state conflict

security.authorization: Later verified permission binds exact compiled spec and cannot replace missing exact approval
limits: Trusted app/Plan immutability before approval transaction
Privileged rewriting of all evidence remains outside host trust boundary

prompt2.restart_condition: Architecture repair resolved at DOC_ONLY level; separately requested implementation first supplies companion/atomic v2 approval/truthful migration/binding validation, then compiler/admission
required_evidence: new v2 APPROVE/REJECT and migrated AwaitingApproval bound
pure reads/reopen and no startup auto-upgrade
prompt2.superseded_eligibility: Migrated v1 Approved Run is not admission-eligible; use a genuinely new bound v2 decision
scope_clarifications: HTTP Action handlers and capability verification remain Prompt 3
Effect key created once at admission, stable through replay/reopen

p2: Separately reviewed legacy consent-refresh/evidence-import and identity/schema revision evolution
Protection against privileged full-ledger rewriting/authenticated human proof
